answered.sql: SELECT Company.name AS companyName, Recruitment_Agency.agencyName AS agencyName FROM Position JOIN Company ON Position.companyId = Company.id JOIN Recruitment_Agency ON Position.recruitmentAgencyId = Recruitment_Agency.id WHERE Position.title = 'Data Analyst'

candidates.sql: SELECT Company.name FROM Company JOIN Position ON Company.id = Position.companyId WHERE Position.title = 'Data Analyst';

candidates.meaning: Identify the entity that hires a data analyst.
candidates.sql: SELECT Company.name FROM Company JOIN Position ON Company.id = Position.companyId WHERE Position.title = 'Data Analyst'

candidates.meaning: List all companies that have a position for a data analyst.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT Company.name FROM Company JOIN Position ON Company.id = Position.companyId WHERE Position.title = 'Data Analyst'

candidates.meaning: Find the company that has hired a data analyst as a candidate.
candidates.sql: SELECT Company.name FROM Company JOIN Position ON Company.id = Position.companyId JOIN Interview ON Position.id = Interview.positionId WHERE Position.title = 'Data Analyst' AND Interview.status = 'Completed'
